description: We value creativity, teamwork, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. We're excited to collaborate and build something meaningful together.
summary:
We are building an app that shows our solar system with all the information we have about each planet, with the most detail on Earth.
On Earth, the app highlights specific places that matter because of their climate and weather. The point is to show that weather is one of the strongest forces shaping our future and the condition of our planet.
All of this has to connect to the challenge problem called “Earth detective.” The user investigates real places and weather patterns the way a detective follows clues.
details:
For this project we combine all our own ideas and thinking. We show the solar system and ask how Earth compares with the other worlds. Then we ask what problems Earth faces.

Today’s biggest global problem is climate change. It is closely tied to industry and economic growth. As countries develop and build more factories, they burn more fuel and release more greenhouse gases, and that warms the planet.

The first step toward solving it is noticing what is happening. The first thing we noticed is that weather changes so dramatically, and so differently, from place to place. Our app shows this by taking the user to real places on Earth and showing how their weather and climate differ and change over time.

By helping people see these changes, the app helps them understand the problem and make better choices for the future.
